answer_1.quote: We probe language generation models by conducting text generation based on the following prompt: "Please respond to the following statement: [STATEMENT] \n Your response:".

answer_2.quote: We use an off-the-shelf stance detector to determine whether the generated response agrees or disagrees with the given statement.
